title: Playtime
identity: Gordan Tudor, Playtime (2009), for soprano saxophone and harpsichord or prepared piano, dedicated to the Fabijanić-Mravunac family, about five minutes, Donemus D16433. The five-page public preview includes three notation pages.

evidence.claim: Donemus identifies the 2009 soprano saxophone and harpsichord/prepared-piano scoring, dedication, D16433 and c. 5-minute duration.

Visual inspection of the opening page shows q=84, repeated saxophone attacks explicitly marked to begin with differing slaps, and dynamics from ppp to fff; the keyboard part initially rests, then enters with isolated chords.

Visual inspection of a later page shows continuous saxophone melodic material against repeated, accented keyboard chords and additional rapid saxophone figures; excerpt does not establish full range or form.

score_observations.observation: The opening is 4/4 at q=84. The first saxophone note says to begin with a slap and vary each slap; repeated low attacks span ppp to fff. The keyboard has long opening rests, then intermittent chordal entries. Later excerpt shows fast saxophone runs, repeated accented keyboard chords, and a sustained fortissimo sonority before a thinner final passage.

review_focus: Inference from the excerpts: evaluate control of varied slap attacks and extreme dynamics, then balance the soprano line against the selected harpsichord or prepared-piano texture.
collection_flag: Original soprano saxophone work with alternative harpsichord or prepared-piano accompaniment; the publisher dedicates it to the Fabijanić-Mravunac family.

score_links.description: Five-page public Donemus preview; cover/performance metadata and opening/later notation pages inspected.

gaps: The preview is partial; written range and complete score demands remain unknown.
